title: Q-REPOS-RECONCILE-SEED-WORKERS: merge the duplicated code in seed/ and workers/ into one tree
body:
**Owner:** engineering
**Trigger:** the executor takes it in driver order
**Status:** open
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/repos_reconcile_check.py

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=workers
code-anchor: Q-REPOS-RECONCILE-SEED-WORKERS

REPOS-1 folded the standalone workers repository in as `workers/` unchanged, so `seed/` and `workers/` overlap (worker core, bootstrap, adapters). Reconcile into one tree: keep the newer behaviour of each module, point imports and the deploy topology at the single copy, keep `npm test` in `workers/` and the seed bootstrap tests green, then remove the duplicate and drop the `workers` skip_dirs entry in doctrine/server-side.json. Probe: workers-tests workflow and the seed tests both pass after the removal.
